name: Noir
source: A mysterious sorcerer who revives Frederick and promises to grant his dying wish of experiencing passionate love. He's actually an incubus and a massive pervert who ships Fred with his male bodyguard and younger brother. [spoiler]He's also the unwitting cause of Frederick's death; he accidentally sucked too much of his life energy, leaving his body vulnerable to infection.[spoiler]
